text: This report recommends approval of the re-naming of a portion of Thorncliffe Park Drive west of Beth Nealson Drive, to "Pat Moore Drive" Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
North York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Pat Moore Drive" for the renaming of a portion of Thorncliffe Park Drive west of Beth Nealson Drive.
